title: Winter Palace
visualBrief: Specific Winter Palace exterior, reused as candidate winter_palace within the unfinished Hermitage main ensemble. Complete native irregular perimeter and six courtyard openings, three true central entrance passages and two recessed side porticoes, green/white three-storey Baroque facade rhythm, projecting risalits/cornices/pediments, faceted green metal roofscape, two distinct gilded/green cupolas, simplified roofline statuary silhouettes and small roof chimneys. Only four integrated Winter Palace records are replaced. Small/Old/New Hermitage, Theatre, connecting passages, detached courtyard hut, gardens, embankment/Neva and Palace Square remain independent native context. No duplicate Winter Palace asset; no furnished imperial rooms, copied reliefs/inscriptions/artworks, ceremonial crowds or off-site museum branches.
